title: From resettlement colony to PG hub: How Satya Niketan was stretched beyond its limits
content: Satya Niketan, once a quiet resettlement colony in Delhi, has evolved into a bustling student enclave. Following the university's expansion in 1973, the area saw a sharp rise in demand for student housing. Properties morphed as they expanded beyond original designs without the requisite approvals. This rapid transformation sparks concerns regarding structural integrity and the adequacy of local infrastructure to support the growing population.

title: 28-year-old killed after TN minister Jagadeeswari’s car hits 2-wheeler in Chennai
content: Tragedy struck on the Trichy-Chennai National Highway early Monday when a 28-year-old man lost his life after his two-wheeler was hit by a car linked to a Tamil Nadu minister. The driver, Chinna Agni, has been arrested for negligent driving. The minister was reportedly ahead in a private vehicle with family. It is revealed that the victim was heading home from a temple festival at the time of the accident.

title: Trophy controversy returns? Mohsin Naqvi to attend India’s Women’s Asia Cup final
content: Mohsin Naqvi, the chairman of the Pakistan Cricket Board and president of the ACC, is set to attend the Women's Asia Cup final. Should India clinch victory, tensions may arise over trophy presentation, reminiscent of last year when India declined to accept the Men's Asia Cup trophy from Naqvi. As India approaches the semi-finals, they emerge as strong contenders for the title.

title: Father of AI Geoffrey Hinton bets on Canada in tariff war with US
content: Geoffrey Hinton's pioneering AI research at the University of Toronto has led to a flourishing technology ecosystem. This vibrant milieu encourages skilled professionals from around the globe, enhanced by Canada's favorable immigration measures. Presently, Toronto stands as the third leading city worldwide for tech talent, outpacing numerous cities in the US.

title: 'Our consent wasn't taken': Punjab govt objects to appointment of new HC CJ
content: The Punjab cabinet passed a resolution against the Centre's appointment of Justice Ashwani Kumar Mishra.  This action was taken after the Centre notified the appointment without state government consent.  Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann stated this violated constitutional norms and procedures.  He described the appointment as an assault on Punjab's rights by the central government.  The state government believes the Centre acted too hastily in this matter.

title: Jeff Bezos' ex-wife sets new record with donations to historically Black colleges
content: MacKenzie Scott has made a remarkable contribution of over one billion dollars to historically Black colleges and universities, with a noteworthy forty-two million dollar donation to Elizabeth City State University marking a pivotal achievement. These generous, unrestricted funds bolster scholarships, enhance faculty resources, and upgrade facilities, showcasing her dedication to expanding educational prospects for diverse communities across the nation.

title: Watch: Deadly pyrotechnic explosion rocks church festival in Mexico, 10 killed
content: During a vibrant religious festival, a tragic pyrotechnic explosion claimed the lives of at least ten individuals and left sixty-four injured. The catastrophe took place near the Nuestra Señora de la Luz church in Temascalcingo, where walls crumbled amidst chaos as fireworks malfunctioned. The explosion was linked to a traditional ritual featuring a straw bull equipped with fireworks, and officials are currently investigating the cause of this heartbreaking event.

title: Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami International Airport; what latest update says
content: An Amazon cargo plane operated by 21 Air crashed while landing at Miami International Airport. The aircraft overran the runway and struck several vehicles, causing a significant fire. Tragically, five people lost their lives in the devastating incident. Five others sustained injuries, with three in critical condition. The Federal Aviation Administration will investigate the cause of this unfortunate event.

title: Private island with Napoleonic fort up for sale - A look at the Venetian dream home
content: A historic fortress on a private island near Venice is now for sale. This island offers a unique blend of military history and secluded waterfront living. The property features a former Napoleonic fort converted into a villa with gardens. It provides stunning views across the Venice lagoon and access by air and water. This rare opportunity combines privacy with proximity to the famous Venetian city.

title: 4 killed, over two dozen injured as bus overturns after hitting divider in UP
content: Four pilgrims died when their bus overturned on the Eastern Peripheral Expressway early Monday. The vehicle hit a road divider near the Badagaon cut, causing the fatal accident. Around thirty-two passengers were travelling from Rajasthan towards Badaun when the crash occurred. Rescuers quickly shifted injured passengers to nearby hospitals for medical treatment. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the serious road crash.

title: ‘Cosmetic surgery’ won’t fix Pakistan: Misbah takes aim at PCB after stepping down
content: Misbah-ul-Haq, the former captain of Pakistan, has voiced his disappointment with the Pakistan Cricket Board's inconsistent policies, particularly regarding the treatment of local versus foreign coaches. He emphasized that knee-jerk reactions under pressure fail to solve issues, and advocated for a thorough evaluation of team performances. Misbah pointed to India's methodical approach to development as an exemplary model for fostering sustained improvement in cricket.

title: Who was Bill Dundee? Wrestling legend and Jerry Lawler’s longtime friend dies
content: Wrestling legend Bill Dundee has died at 82, his son Jamie Dundee announced Sunday, with no cause of death disclosed. Born in Scotland and raised in Australia, Dundee built his career in Memphis alongside longtime rival and partner Jerry "The King" Lawler, collecting multiple AWA and CWA titles along the way. He was inducted into the Memphis Wrestling Hall of Fame in 2017 and made his final televised appearance just one day before his death.

title: Who is Brittany Mahomes? How she built a legacy beyond Patrick Mahomes
content: Brittany Mahomes has built an identity far beyond being Patrick Mahomes’ wife. A former soccer player, she turned her athletic background into a fitness business before becoming a founding co-owner of the Kansas City Current. Her work has helped advance women’s soccer, including the development of a purpose-built stadium. Through business, sports and philanthropy, Brittany continues to use her platform to encourage women to embrace confidence, ambition and their own path.

title: Satya Niketan exposes Delhi’s harsh truth: Students risk lives for a future
content: The devastating collapse of a building in Satya Niketan has resulted in the loss of five students' lives, underscoring the urgent issue of unsafe housing. Around Delhi, student colonies face identical dangers from unchecked construction practices. Previous tragedies in areas like Old Rajinder Nagar and Saidulajab highlight a concerning trend.

He is now awaiting further details regarding the specific role and responsibilities.

title: Email ID in another person’s name not identity theft, Allahabad HC rules
content: The Allahabad high court has stayed an FIR against two individuals.  They were accused of creating an email ID in another person's name.  The court questioned if this action constituted identity theft under IT Act.  It noted the law specifically mentions electronic signatures and passwords, not email IDs.  The FIR was stayed pending further orders from the court.

title: Ambulance stuck in pothole for 2 hours, unborn baby dies in Agra
content: An unborn child died in Agra after an ambulance got stuck in a large pothole. The vehicle remained immobilized for over two hours, delaying critical medical arrival. Villagers attempted to free the ambulance, but the delay proved fatal for the baby. The family reached the health center too late to save the child. Officials are now probing the incident and promising road repairs.

title: Gen Next sets the pace: Pacers eye India selection after 13,000-strong talent hunt

Among them, Akshita Bhagat has secured a place in the India A squad, while Joshna Angel and Palak Singh are aspiring for the India U-19 team. title: Homeopaths turn to allopathy amid job insecurity in Maharashtra
content: Homeopaths are now practicing modern medicine after receiving pharmacology certificates. Many practitioners lack access to qualified MBBS doctors in their areas. This situation forces locals to seek cheaper and more accessible alternative practitioners. These practitioners often dispense allopathic medicines for various ailments. Experts suggest more rigorous training could utilize their existing skills effectively.

title: Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen linked to $32B FTX collapse over $2M stakes
